sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔维尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Five years ago, a TV personality and comedian, Vladimir Zelensky, won the presidency in Ukraine in a landslide victory.
sentences.zh: 五年前，电视名人和喜剧演员弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在乌克兰总统大选中以压倒性优势获胜。

sentences.en: And then, after three years in office, he faced the biggest challenge of his presidency and of his life.
sentences.zh: 然后，在执政三年后，他面临着他总统生涯和一生中最大的挑战。

sentences.en: This is only the beginning for Russia on the Ukrainian land.
sentences.zh: 这只是俄罗斯在乌克兰土地上的开始。

sentences.en: Russia is trying to defeat the freedom of all people in Europe.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯正试图击败欧洲所有人民的自由。

sentences.en: He rose to that challenge, beating back one of the world's largest armies.
sentences.zh: 他迎难而上，击退了世界最大军队之一。

sentences.en: But now...
sentences.zh: 但现在……

sentences.en: We urgently need patroot systems and missiles for them.
sentences.zh: 我们迫切需要爱国者防空系统和相应的导弹。

sentences.en: And you can imagine what our soldiers feel when they simply have nothing to respond to enemy fire.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象我们的士兵在对敌人的火力根本无力还击时的感受。

sentences.en: The tide has turned against him.
sentences.zh: 局势已经对她不利。

sentences.en: Please, do not ask Ukraine when the war will end.
sentences.zh: 请不要问乌克兰战争何时结束。

sentences.en: Ask yourself, why is Putin still able to continue it?
sentences.zh: 问问你自己，为什么普京仍然能够继续这场战争？

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Andrew Kramer, sat down with Zelensky to talk about the fight of his life and how it might end.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安德鲁·克雷默坐下来与泽连斯基交谈，谈论他一生中最重要的战斗以及它可能如何结束。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月4日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Andrew, you've been covering Ukraine for many years.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，你报道乌克兰已经很多年了。

sentences.en: And you first met President Zelensky back in 2020, before Russia invaded.
sentences.zh: 你第一次见泽连斯基总统是在2020年，也就是俄罗斯入侵之前。

sentences.en: Tell us what he was like back then.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲他当时是什么样的人。

sentences.en: There's just an incredible density of events that have filled Zelensky's tenure as president.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基的总统任期内充满了密集的事件。

sentences.en: I had an opportunity to interview President Zelensky in 2020.
sentences.zh: 我在2020年有机会采访了泽连斯基总统。

sentences.en: And this was during COVID.
sentences.zh: 当时正值新冠疫情期间。

sentences.en: So it was a Zoom interview.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次Zoom采访。

sentences.en: And it was really a different era for Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 对泽连斯基来说，那确实是一个不同的时代。

sentences.en: He had just come in as president.
sentences.zh: 他刚上任总统不久。

sentences.en: He was baby-faced.
sentences.zh: 他长着一张娃娃脸。

sentences.en: He was a fresh presence in Ukrainian politics.
sentences.zh: 他是乌克兰政坛的一个清新面孔。

sentences.en: And at this moment, he was trying to reset relations with the United States.
sentences.zh: 当时，他正试图重置与美国的关系。

sentences.en: There had been tensions with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 此前与特朗普政府之间存在紧张关系。

sentences.en: And he wanted to turn a new page in bilateral relations.
sentences.zh: 他希望在双边关系中翻开新的一页。

sentences.en: And by tension with the Trump administration, you mean, of course, that Zelensky was in the middle of the first Trump impeachment.
sentences.zh: 你所说的与特朗普政府的紧张关系，当然是指泽连斯基卷入了特朗普的第一次弹劾案。

sentences.en: We may all forget, but Trump made a phone call to Zelensky asking him to investigate not only Joe Biden, but also his son, Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们可能都忘了，特朗普给泽连斯基打了个电话，要求他调查乔·拜登以及他的儿子亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: And Trump hinted that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普还暗示，如果泽连斯基不这么做

sentences.en: would actually withhold military aid if Zelensky didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 美国实际上会扣留军事援助。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The perfect phone call.
sentences.zh: 完美的电话。

sentences.en: That's what President Trump called it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统就是这么称呼它的。

sentences.en: And during this time, Zelensky became briefly a known figure in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在那期间，泽连斯基在美国短暂成了一个知名人物。

sentences.en: But in Ukraine, he was known as a charismatic leader.
sentences.zh: 但在乌克兰，他被称为一个有个人魅力的领袖。

sentences.en: He was a television personality before becoming president.
sentences.zh: 在成为总统之前，他是一位电视名人。

sentences.en: And he had campaigned on an idea of a new morning in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时提出了乌克兰迎来新早晨的理念。

sentences.en: He would crack down on corruption.
sentences.zh: 他将严厉打击腐败。

sentences.en: And a central element of his campaign had been to make peace with Russia.
sentences.zh: 他竞选的核心要素之一是与俄罗斯实现和平。

sentences.en: It's pretty interesting to remember, actually, that Zelensky started as someone who thought it was possible to make peace with Russia.
sentences.zh: 回想起来其实挺有趣的，泽连斯基最初认为有可能与俄罗斯实现和平。

sentences.en: That's who he was as a politician when he started out.
sentences.zh: 他刚出道从政时就是这样的人。

sentences.en: And he had wide support.
sentences.zh: 他得到了广泛的支持。

sentences.en: He was elected with 73 percent of the vote.
sentences.zh: 他以73%的得票率当选。

sentences.en: So a lot of Ukrainians believed that he would actually be able to achieve this.
sentences.zh: 因此许多乌克兰人相信他真的能够实现这一点。

sentences.en: But this had really fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 但这已经彻底破裂了。

sentences.en: And by the time I talked to him late in 2020, the prospects for these negotiations were very unclear.
sentences.zh: 到2020年底我与他交谈时，这些谈判的前景非常不明朗。

sentences.en: And it was, for this reason, more important than ever for the Zelensky administration to shore up support from the United States.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，泽连斯基政府巩固来自美国的支持比以往任何时候都更加重要。

sentences.en: So that was 2020.
A lot has changed.
sentences.zh: 很多事情都变了。

sentences.en: Clearly, at this point, Zelensky is not making peace with Russia anymore.
sentences.zh: 显然，此时的泽连斯基不再与俄罗斯谋求和平了。

sentences.en: You sat down with Zelensky a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 你几周前和泽连斯基坐下来进行了长谈。

sentences.en: Why did you want to talk to him again now?
sentences.zh: 你为什么现在又想和他谈谈？

sentences.en: Well, it's a very interesting and critical moment in the war.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是战争中一个非常有趣且关键的时刻。

sentences.en: The tide has turned in the war.
sentences.zh: 战争的局势已经逆转。

sentences.en: Russia is pressing all along the front.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在整个前线发起进攻。

sentences.en: And American aid had been stalled for six months.
sentences.zh: 美国的援助已经停滞了六个月。

sentences.en: And it was passed recently in Congress, but it hasn't yet arrived.
sentences.zh: 虽然最近在国会通过了，但尚未运达。

sentences.en: So it's a moment where Zelensky has his back against the wall.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个泽连斯基被逼入绝境的时刻。

sentences.en: And what Zelensky has really zeroed in on is that the NATO countries in the United States should allow Ukraine to use donated Western weaponry to hit targets inside of Russia.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基真正关注的重点是，北约国家和美国应该允许乌克兰使用捐赠的西方武器打击俄罗斯境内的目标。

sentences.en: Now, of course, firing American weapons into Russia has really been a red line for the United States
sentences.zh: 当然，用美国武器攻击俄罗斯一直是美国划定的红线

sentences.en: through the more than two years of this conflict, because Russia is a nuclear armed power.
sentences.zh: 在这两年多的冲突中，因为俄罗斯是一个拥有核武器的大国。

sentences.en: And there have always been fears in the background that this would be provocative, this would be escalatory, and would really raise the risk of a wider war.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在担心这会具有挑衅性、升级局势，并真正增加爆发更大规模战争的风险。

sentences.en: So we wanted to understand how Zelensky was making that argument for Biden to allow him to use American weapons to hit targets inside of Russia, despite the risks.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想了解泽连斯基是如何向拜登阐明这一论点的，即尽管存在风险，仍要允许他使用美国武器打击俄罗斯境内的目标。

sentences.en: So tell me about your interview.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你的采访吧。

sentences.en: Start from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 从头开始。

sentences.en: Are we recording now?
sentences.zh: 我们现在在录音吗？

sentences.en: Well, we walked into the presidential administration through very tight security.
sentences.zh: 我们通过非常严格的安检走进了总统行政大楼。

sentences.en: It's always an interesting experience arriving at the presidential office in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 抵达基辅总统办公室总是一次有趣的经历。

sentences.en: We have their sandbags and anti-tank barriers around the building.
sentences.zh: 大楼周围有沙袋和反坦克路障。

sentences.en: Andrew, you'll sit up on the right, closest to the president.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，你坐在右边，离总统最近。

sentences.en: Yeah, we can get Andrew.
sentences.zh: 对，我们可以让安德鲁坐那。

sentences.en: We made our way through the compound to a ceremonial reception hall.
sentences.zh: 我们穿过大院来到一个礼仪接待厅。

sentences.en: This was in a 19th-century building with exotic plaster moldings on the walls called the House of Chimras.
sentences.zh: 这是一座19世纪的建筑，墙上有异国情调的石膏线脚，被称为奇美拉宫。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's okay for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说可以。

sentences.en: It's good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: And I went to interview Zelensky with my colleagues, Phil Pan, the international editor, and Bill Brink, the Ukraine editor.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事国际主编菲尔·潘以及乌克兰主编比尔·布林克一起去采访了泽连斯基。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We waited there for about an hour before the president showed up.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里等了大约一个小时，总统才出现。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm a good place.
sentences.zh: 我找了个好地方。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: President, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: How was three?
sentences.zh: 怎么是三个？

sentences.en: Nine.
sentences.zh: 九。

sentences.en: When he walks into a room, you immediately notice that he's there, that he's a presence.
sentences.zh: 当他走进房间时，你立刻会注意到他在那里，他很有气场。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I believe you know Andrew Kramer.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我想你认识安德鲁·克雷默。

sentences.en: He's our beer chief here.
sentences.zh: 他是我们这里的啤酒（应为 bureau 记者站，但按音译或口误处理，此处译为记者站主管或保持原意）负责人。

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: Well, we had an interview, but it was by Skype in 2020, I think.
sentences.zh: 我们做过采访，但那是2020年通过Skype进行的，我想是吧。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Maybe I'm sorry, it was in another life.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，对不起，那是另一辈子的事了。

sentences.en: And he is a little bit shorter in real life than he might appear on television.
sentences.zh: 现实生活中的他比在电视上看起来要稍微矮一点。

sentences.en: And war has changed Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 战争改变了泽连斯基。

sentences.en: He looks haggard.
sentences.zh: 他看起来面容憔悴。

sentences.en: And for the last two years, he's been bearded and wearing only military fatigues.
sentences.zh: 在过去的两年里，他一直留着胡子，只穿军便服。

sentences.en: In this case, it was a green T-shirt and green trousers.
sentences.zh: 这次是一件绿色T恤和绿色长裤。

sentences.en: But he did seem to be holding up all right.
sentences.zh: 但他看起来状态还不错。

sentences.en: He looked healthy and he was very energetic.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很健康，精力非常充沛。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的到来。

sentences.en: We can sit?
sentences.zh: 我们可以坐吗？

sentences.en: After some small talk in English.
sentences.zh: 用英语进行了一些闲聊之后。

sentences.en: Can we check Ukrainian translation?
sentences.zh: 我们可以检查乌克兰语翻译吗？

sentences.en: Talk.
sentences.zh: 聊聊。

sentences.en: We talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我们谈谈这个。

sentences.en: He switched into Ukrainian and we spoke with him through a translator.
sentences.zh: 他切换到乌克兰语，我们通过翻译与他交谈。

sentences.en: The Biden administration has prohibited Ukraine from using American-made weapons to strike inside Russia out of concern for escalation, including the risk of nuclear war.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府禁止乌克兰使用美国制造的武器打击俄罗斯境内，出于对局势升级的担忧，包括核战争的风险。

sentences.en: And our very first question was about this red line.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个问题就是关于这条红线的。

sentences.en: Your government has urged a change to this policy, given the situation on the battlefield right now.
sentences.zh: 鉴于目前的战场局势，贵国政府一直敦促改变这一政策。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, Biden administration was really against the use of the Western weapons.
sentences.zh: 首先，拜登政府真的反对使用西方武器。

sentences.en: That's important to mention.
sentences.zh: 这一点值得一提。

sentences.en: And he became quite animated.
sentences.zh: 他变得相当情绪激动。

sentences.en: He was gesturing.
sentences.zh: 他在做手势。

sentences.en: He was using his skills as a public speaker to convey what he felt was a very important point.
sentences.zh: 他运用自己作为公众演说家的技巧来表达他认为非常重要的一点。

sentences.en: They are striking with the missiles from Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 他们正用俄罗斯领土上的导弹进行攻击。

sentences.en: So how can we protect ourselves from these strikes?
sentences.zh: 那么我们如何保护自己免受这些袭击呢？

sentences.en: And he was saying that it's really not possible for him to fight when the Russians can gather their forces and fly their airplanes in Russia and then attack Ukraine when he is not allowed to strike back as they gather across the border.
sentences.zh: 他说，当俄罗斯人可以在俄罗斯境内集结部队并驾驶飞机，然后在乌克兰不被允许回击的情况下袭击乌克兰时，他根本无法作战，因为敌人在边境彼岸集结。

sentences.en: They are in the closest villages and settlements to the border from Russia, knowing that we will not respond.
sentences.zh: 他们位于俄罗斯边境最近的村庄和定居点，知道我们不会做出回应。

sentences.en: He was conveying this sense of fighting with one hand tied behind his back.
sentences.zh: 他传达了这种如同双手被绑在身后作战的感觉。

sentences.en: And they have to endure the attacks from Russia, the bombings and the artillery strikes.
sentences.zh: 他们必须忍受来自俄罗斯的攻击、轰炸和炮击。

sentences.en: And they're not allowed to hit back.
sentences.zh: 而他们却不被允许还击。

sentences.en: That is their big, big advantage.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们巨大、巨大的优势。

sentences.en: And then he talked about the northeastern part of Ukraine, near Ukraine's second largest city, Kharkiv.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到了乌克兰东北部，靠近乌克兰第二大城市哈尔科夫的地区。

sentences.en: It's been a target of Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 那是俄罗斯进攻的目标。

sentences.en: It's bombarded almost daily.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都遭到轰炸。

sentences.en: And it's now one of the focal points of the war.
sentences.zh: 它现在是战争的焦点之一。

sentences.en: To defend Kharkiv, Ukraine has been forced to divert soldiers from elsewhere to fight this Russian incursion with the city at their backs.
sentences.zh: 为了保卫哈尔科夫，乌克兰被迫从其他地方抽调士兵，背水一战来抵御俄罗斯的这次入侵。

sentences.en: Russia is piling up the troops.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯正在堆积军队。

sentences.en: They are...
sentences.zh: 他们正在……

sentences.en: And Zelensky was telling us that his intelligence can see the Russians unloading from trains, weaponry and equipment just across the border in Russia.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基告诉我们，他的情报部门可以看到俄罗斯人正在俄罗斯边境的另一侧从火车上卸下武器和装备。

sentences.en: But he's not allowed to strike it because of the restriction on the use of western weaponry.
sentences.zh: 但由于对使用西方武器的限制，他不能进行打击。

sentences.en: And so he said he has no choice but to watch them prepare to attack.
sentences.zh: 因此他说他别无选择，只能看着他们准备发动攻击。

sentences.en: It means that tomorrow they won't come to us, they will come to us with death, right?
sentences.zh: 这意味着明天他们不会对我们，他们会带着死亡来找我们，对吗？

sentences.en: And he had a very vivid image for this.
sentences.zh: 对此他有一个非常生动的比喻。

sentences.en: He was saying that he sees the Russians gathering on that side of the border.
sentences.zh: 他说他看到俄罗斯人在边界的那一边集结。

sentences.en: That means that tomorrow they will not give us flowers, they will give us death.
sentences.zh: 这意味着明天他们不会给我们鲜花，他们会给我们带来死亡。

sentences.en: And that he knows they aren't coming with flowers, but they're coming with death.
sentences.zh: 并且他知道他们不是带着鲜花来的，而是带着死亡来的。

sentences.en: If we know that tomorrow they are not celebrating with us, but they are killing us, why can't we use our weapons to demolish them in the point of collection of the arms?
sentences.zh: 如果我们知道明天他们不是在和我们庆祝，而是在杀死我们，为什么我们不能用我们的武器在武器集结地消灭他们？

sentences.en: In other words, what he was saying was that they're basically sitting ducks.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他的意思是他们基本上成了任人宰割的羔羊。

sentences.en: And if he could only use these big, powerful American weapons to shoot inside of Russia, you know, to take the war to Russians, then that could turn the tide of the war.
sentences.zh: 如果他能使用这些强大而先进的美国武器在俄罗斯境内射击，你知道的，把战争带到俄罗斯人那里，那么这可能会扭转战局。

sentences.en: But the Americans were just not letting him do that.
sentences.zh: 但美国人就是不让他这么做。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's also asking for very specific weaponry to do this.
sentences.zh: 而且他还在索取非常具体的武器来做到这一点。

sentences.en: And it really sort of speaks to Zelensky's life over the past two and a half years.
sentences.zh: 这确实在某种程度上说明了泽连斯基过去两年半的生活。

sentences.en: His country depends on an arsenal of weaponry from allies who have often been reluctant to provide it.
sentences.zh: 他的国家依靠盟友提供的武器库，而这些盟友往往不愿提供。

sentences.en: And he finds himself often coming with what amounts to a shopping list to these Western nations, describing what his military needs in any particular circumstance.
sentences.zh: 他发现自己经常带着相当于购物清单的东西来到这些西方国家，描述他的军队在任何特定情况下所需的东西。

sentences.en: We can get, in the end of the day, from NATO countries.
sentences.zh: 我们最终可以从北约国家获得。

sentences.en: And what he told us.
sentences.zh: 而他告诉我们的是。

sentences.en: Seven.
sentences.zh: 七个。

sentences.en: Patriot systeMs.
sentences.zh: 爱国者系统。

sentences.en: Seven.
sentences.zh: 七个。

sentences.en: Was that he needed seven Patriot anti-aircraft missile systeMs.
sentences.zh: 他需要七套“爱国者”防空导弹系统。

sentences.en: Our analysts told us we need 120, 130 F-16s.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析师告诉我们，我们需要120、130架F-16。

sentences.en: And 120 to 130 F-16 airplanes.
sentences.zh: 还有120到130架F-16战斗机。

sentences.en: And these kind of requests, well, understandable.
sentences.zh: 这类要求，嗯，是可以理解的。

sentences.en: His soldiers are engaged in combat.
sentences.zh: 他的士兵正在参战。

sentences.en: They're suffering casualties.
sentences.zh: 他们正在遭受伤亡。

sentences.en: And civilians are being killed.
sentences.zh: 平民也在被杀害。

sentences.en: So it's of dire importance to Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 所以这对泽连斯基来说至关重要。

sentences.en: But these type of requests have sometimes graded on Western politicians.
sentences.zh: 但这类要求有时会让西方政客感到厌烦。

sentences.en: So much so that last summer, the British Minister of Defense had said in response and really in frustration that Zelensky, we're not Amazon.
sentences.zh: 以至于去年夏天，英国国防大臣在回应时表现出极大的沮丧，说泽连斯基，我们不是亚马逊。

sentences.en: Don't come with a shopping liSt.
sentences.zh: 别带着购物清单来。

sentences.en: And this, of course, has been the view of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是美国的观点。

sentences.en: administration as well.
sentences.zh: 政府也是如此。

sentences.en: Like, hey, guy, we just gave you $60 billion.
sentences.zh: 就像，嘿，老兄，我们刚给了你600亿美元。

sentences.en: Have some gratitude.
sentences.zh: 怀有一点感恩之心吧。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So it's clear why shooting American weapons into Russia would help Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，用美国武器射击俄罗斯会如何帮助泽连斯基。

sentences.en: But how is he viewing the risk of Russia retaliating and potentially setting off a nuclear war?
sentences.zh: 但他如何看待俄罗斯报复并可能引发核战争的风险？

sentences.en: Because, of course, that's why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，这就是美国最初。

sentences.en: drew this red line in the first place, right?
sentences.zh: 划下这条红线的原因，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, this is really the question of the hour on escalation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是当今关于局势升级的关键问题。

sentences.en: What do you say to the people who argue that it is too risky to allow Ukraine to use these weapons inside Russia because of the risk of escalation?
sentences.zh: 你对那些认为允许乌克兰在俄罗斯境内使用这些武器风险太大，因为存在局势升级风险的人有什么看法？

sentences.en: There are no risks of escalation.
sentences.zh: 根本没有局势升级的风险。

sentences.en: And when we asked about this, Zelensky asked us, in a sense, to get inside Putin's head a little bit and understand how he sees this playing out.
sentences.zh: 当我们问及此事时，泽连斯基要求我们在某种程度上走进普京的头脑，去理解他是如何看待这一切发展的。

sentences.en: He was saying that Putin is an irrational actor, so obviously somebody to be feared.
sentences.zh: 他说普京是一个非理性的人，所以显然是一个令人害怕的人。

sentences.en: That he could use the nuclear weapon then when he failed to conquer us during the first year of the war.
sentences.zh: 当他在战争第一年未能征服我们时，他本可以使用核武器。

sentences.en: But if he were to use nuclear weapons, he would have used them in the first year of the war when Russia was down and Ukraine was up.
sentences.zh: 但如果他要使用核武器，他会在战争第一年俄罗斯处于劣势而乌克兰处于优势时就使用了。

sentences.en: And he was also saying that he did not use it because he really loves his own life.
sentences.zh: 他还说他没有使用，是因为他真的很珍视自己的生命。

sentences.en: Putin, he's irrational, but he would also fear for his own life.
sentences.zh: 普京，他是不理性的，但他也同样珍视自己的生命。

sentences.en: And he understands that that's it.
sentences.zh: 并且他明白那就是结局。

sentences.en: The door will be totally locked to Russia, fully locked, if he uses nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 如果他使用核武器，通往俄罗斯的大门将彻底关闭，完全关闭。

sentences.en: It's a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个事实。

sentences.en: And no one will be able to do anything with that.
sentences.zh: 对此任何人也无能为力。

sentences.en: Even his fans among the politicians, they won't be able to do anything because the use of the nuclear weapon is not the red line.
sentences.zh: 甚至他在政客中的崇拜者，他们也将无能为力，因为使用核武器并非红线。

sentences.en: This is a totally different level.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全不同的层面。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: This is the World War III.
sentences.zh: 这就是第三次世界大战。

sentences.en: Using a nuclear weapon would obviously be risking World War III, and Putin would understand the consequences of this.
sentences.zh: 使用核武器显然会冒着第三次世界大战的风险，普京会明白这样做的后果。

sentences.en: So these were Zelensky's explanations of why he felt the Russians were bluffing on the nuclear question.
sentences.zh: 这就是泽连斯基解释为什么他觉得俄罗斯人在核问题上是在虚张声势。

sentences.en: So Zelensky's conclusion was that the nuclear threat really isn't real.
sentences.zh: 所以泽连斯基的结论是核威胁其实并非真的。

sentences.en: That it's not that much of a risk then for the West to let Ukraine cross that red line.
sentences.zh: 因此，西方让乌克兰跨越那条红线其实并没有那么大的风险。

sentences.en: Use those American weapons to shoot at Russians inside Russia.
sentences.zh: 使用那些美国武器射击俄罗斯境内的俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: Yes, and then last week, apparently Biden was convinced by Zelensky's arguments.
sentences.zh: 是的，然后就在上周，拜登显然被泽连斯基的论点说服了。

sentences.en: The Biden administration officials announced that American weapons could be used to hit targets inside of Russia.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府官员宣布，美国武器可以用来打击俄罗斯境内的目标。

sentences.en: The decision to shift was weighing the risk of losing Ukraine's second largest city, Kharkiv, or having it bombed into oblivion against a very small risk of a nuclear war,
sentences.zh: 做出转变的决定是在权衡失去乌克兰第二大城市哈尔科夫的风险，或是让它被轰炸成废墟，与发生核战争的极小风险之间進行权衡，

sentences.en: a large risk of losing a city and a small risk of nuclear war.
sentences.zh: 失去一座城市的巨大风险和发生核战争的小风险。

sentences.en: But there were caveats.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些附加条件。

sentences.en: The American permission only allowed the use of American weapons on the border and in response to Russian military attacks across the border on Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 美国的许可仅允许在边境使用美国武器，以回应俄罗斯越境对乌克兰发起的军事攻击。

sentences.en: And it didn't cover the most powerful rocket in the arsenal that the United States has provided, the ATAKAMS-guided rocket.
sentences.zh: 并且它不包括美国提供的威力最强大的火箭弹，即“陆军战术导弹系统”（ATAKAMS）制导火箭弹。

sentences.en: So we won't see Ukrainian attacks on large Russian cities using American weapons such as rocket attacks on Moscow.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不会看到乌克兰使用美国武器对俄罗斯大城市发动攻击，比如对莫斯科的火箭弹袭击。

sentences.en: But it is evidence that the Biden administration has shifted red line.
sentences.zh: 但这证明了拜登政府已经改变了红线。

sentences.en: And it seems significant even if it's limited.
sentences.zh: 而且即使有所限制，这似乎也意义重大。

sentences.en: So the red line maybe isn't actually so red.
sentences.zh: 所以这条红线其实也许没那么红。

sentences.en: What do you think this tells us?
sentences.zh: 你认为这说明了什么？

sentences.en: It tells us that Zelensky has been persuasive with his style of public performance, with his style of reaching out directly to voters in the countries that are allies with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这说明泽连斯基凭借其公开表演的风格，凭借他直接接触乌克兰盟友国家选民的风格，具有很强的说服力。

sentences.en: He has pushed Western leaders to shift on red lines and to continually provide more military support for his military and change their policies on how they assist Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他一直在推动西方领导人在红线问题上做出转变，并不断为他的军队提供更多军事支持，并改变他们协助乌克兰的政策。

sentences.en: But Zelensky has another challenge.
sentences.zh: 但泽连斯基面临着另一个挑战。

sentences.en: It's something he doesn't talk about nearly as much.
sentences.zh: 这是他几乎没有怎么谈及的事情。

sentences.en: But it's just as important to winning the war.
sentences.zh: 但这对于赢得战争同样重要。

sentences.en: And this is a challenge inside Ukraine, in Ukrainian society.
sentences.zh: 这是乌克兰国内、乌克兰社会内部的挑战。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报的游戏是由你们刚刚听过的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, Andrew, you said that there was another big potential problem for Zelensky, and that was a problem in Ukrainian society.
sentences.zh: 所以，安德鲁，你说泽连斯基面临另一个巨大的潜在问题，那就是乌克兰社会的问题。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个。

sentences.en: In short, it comes down to this.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，归结为这一点。

sentences.en: Not enough men want to fight, and Zelensky doesn't know how to make them.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的人想要参战，而泽连斯基不知道该如何强迫他们。

sentences.en: He has been drafting men in relatively small batches throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 他在全国范围内以相对较小的批次征召男性入伍。

sentences.en: And those who have signed up in the beginning, they are still serving at the front and have been fighting continuously for two years.
sentences.zh: 而那些一开始就报名的人，他们仍然在前线服役，并已经连续战斗了两年。

sentences.en: So, there's fatigue of soldiers who are fighting and in the army, and there's also reluctance of those who have not yet been drafted to be drafted into the military.
sentences.zh: 因此，正在战斗和在军队中的士兵感到疲惫，而那些尚未被征召的人则对被征服入伍感到抗拒。

sentences.en: So, Andrew, I'm really thinking about this with you and remembering back to those early days when you and I were walking around the streets of Kiev and going into draft offices
sentences.zh: 所以，安德鲁，我真的在和你一起思考这个问题，并回想起那些早期的日子，当时你和我走在基辅的街道上，走进征兵办公室

sentences.en: and seeing everybody who signed up, right?
sentences.zh: 看到所有报名的人，对吧？

sentences.en: History professors.
sentences.zh: 历史教授。

sentences.en: I think you even interviewed a male stripper at some point that we were kind of remarking on.
sentences.zh: 我想你甚至在某个时候采访过一个我们当时有所议论的男脱衣舞舞者。

sentences.en: Everybody wanted to fight, but that is very different now.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想参战，但现在情况大不相同了。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What changed?
sentences.zh: 什么改变了？

sentences.en: It's now been two years, and there's been a lot of dying.
sentences.zh: 现在已经两年了，有很多人死亡。

sentences.en: If you look at the number of men serving in the Ukrainian military now, including some units like the National Guard and Border Guards, it's about one million men under arMs.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看现在在乌克兰军队服役的男性的数量，包括国民警卫队和边防部队等一些单位，大约有一百万名现役军人。

sentences.en: Out of that one million, about 10% have died so far.
sentences.zh: 在这一百万中，到目前为止大约有10%的人已经牺牲。

sentences.en: We don't know the exact number of casualties in the Ukrainian army, but estimates are in the range of about 100,000 Ukrainian soldiers who have been killed over two years of war.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道乌克兰军队伤亡的确切数字，但估计在两年战争中阵亡的乌克兰士兵大约有10万人左右。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: One thing that I've found really remarkable when you travel around in villages and towns is that there are almost always dry flowers all over the roads
sentences.zh: 当我环游各个村庄和小镇时，我发现有一件事真的非常引人注目，那就是道路两旁几乎总是铺满枯萎的鲜花

sentences.en: because there are funerals so often, and they put these flowers down, and then they have a procession.
sentences.zh: 因为葬礼太频繁了，他们把这些花放下，然后举行游行送葬。

sentences.en: So military vehicles will come very slowly carrying a body and a hearse, and people will get out of their cars,
sentences.zh: 因此，载着遗体和灵车的军用车辆会非常缓慢地行驶，人们会从车里走出来，

sentences.en: and they'll kneel on the side of the road while this procession goes by.
sentences.zh: 当送葬队伍经过时，他们会跪在路边。

sentences.en: And it's these sort of scenes that are really frightening to men who are eligible for the draft and who know what it would mean to be called up and sent into the trench fighting.
sentences.zh: 正是这些场景让符合征兵条件的男性感到非常害怕，他们知道被征召并被派往战壕战斗意味着什么。

sentences.en: And how many men are eligible for the draft?
sentences.zh: 有多少男性符合征兵条件？

sentences.en: In Ukraine, there are three to four million men who could be drafted and could be serving in the military.
sentences.zh: 在乌克兰，有300万到400万男性可以被征召并在军队服役。

sentences.en: So they could be fighting a war of attrition with Russia, with a larger army, were they able to mobilize and equip these additional soldiers.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们能够动员并装备这些额外的士兵，他们就能与拥有更大军队的俄罗斯进行一场消耗战。

sentences.en: But they haven't done this, and there's been quite a bit of reluctance.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有这样做，并且存在相当多的抗拒。

sentences.en: So they're at a moment now where they need soldiers, but the patriotic wave from earlier in the war has really washed over.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在正处于这样一个时刻：他们需要士兵，但战争早期的爱国热潮实际上已经消退。

sentences.en: And at this point, they're going to have to use the power of calling up men against their will in order to continue fighting this war.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，他们将不得不利用违背男性意愿强行征召的力量，以便继续这场战争。

sentences.en: What does that look like in Ukraine now?
sentences.zh: 现在乌克兰的情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, the call-up of men from villages in some areas of Ukraine has been so great that there are villages without men.
sentences.zh: 嗯，乌克兰某些地区的村庄征召男性的规模如此之大，以至于出现了没有男性的村庄。

sentences.en: There are villages where women, when they see the draft officials coming into town, they have swarmed these vehicles
sentences.zh: 在一些村庄里，妇女们看到征兵官员进城时，她们会蜂拥围住这些车辆

sentences.en: and are protesting to protect the few remaining men in these areas.
sentences.zh: 并进行抗议，以保护这些地区仅存的少数男性。

sentences.en: There have been roadblocks put up in Kiev and other towns to stop cars and check draft registration documents on the street.
sentences.zh: 基辅和其他城镇设置了路障，用来拦截车辆并在街上检查征兵登记文件。

sentences.en: And sometimes men are asked to report to basic training within as little of a week after being stopped at one of these surprise checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 有时，在这些突击检查站被拦下后短短一周内，男性就会被要求前往接受基础训练。

sentences.en: And this has been disruptive, and men are fearful of being caught in one of these roadblocks and approached by draft officials.
sentences.zh: 这造成了混乱，男性很害怕在这些路障中被抓到并被征兵官员接近。

sentences.en: And there are even social media apps that track where they're moving around town.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有社交媒体应用程序来追踪他们在城里的移动轨迹。

sentences.en: For example, in Kiev, there's an app called Weather in Kiev, and it'll say it's raining on a certain intersection.
sentences.zh: 例如，在基辅，有一个名为“基辅天气”的应用程序，它会显示某处十字路口正在下雨。

sentences.en: And that would mean that the draft officials are there and men should avoid that area.
sentences.zh: 这就意味着征兵官员在那里，男性应该避开该地区。

sentences.en: And is Zelensky acknowledging this challenge?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基是否承认这个挑战？

sentences.en: I mean, the challenge of trying to get men to fight in the war?
sentences.zh: 我是说，试图让男性参战的挑战？

sentences.en: Politically, Zelensky has disassociated himself from the challenges of the draft.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，泽连斯基已将自己与征兵面临的挑战划清界限。

sentences.en: He's said this is a problem for parliament or for the military.
sentences.zh: 他说这是议会或军方的问题。

sentences.en: It's politically very unpopular.
sentences.zh: 这在政治上非常不受欢迎。

sentences.en: And he hasn't, for example, given major speeches calling on Ukrainians to sign up and explaining the draft policies.
sentences.zh: 例如，他没有发表重要演讲号召乌克兰人报名参战并解释征兵政策。

sentences.en: It's also very difficult.
sentences.zh: 这也非常困难。

sentences.en: In our interview, he did, though, acknowledge the toll of the war on Ukrainian society.
sentences.zh: 不过，在我们的采访中，他确实承认了战争对乌克兰社会造成的代价。

sentences.en: And he described this as divisions.
sentences.zh: 他将这描述为分裂。

sentences.en: Humanity starts to deal with someone in the war, and someone in the war.
sentences.zh: 人类开始与战争中的某人，以及不在战争中的某人打交道。

sentences.en: Some people are at war, some people are not.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在经历战争，有些人则没有。

sentences.en: That there had been some rift in society between men who are fighting and men who are not fighting.
sentences.zh: 社会上的参战男性与未参战男性之间存在某种裂痕。

sentences.en: It is really serious, because the society begins to divide.
sentences.zh: 这真的很严重，因为社会开始分裂。

sentences.en: And for somebody trying to steer a country in a war, this could be a problem.
sentences.zh: 对于一个试图在战争中掌舵一个国家的人来说，这可能是一个问题。

sentences.en: This separation in the society, this division, at this moment, the enemy can use it.
sentences.zh: 社会中的这种分离，这种分裂，此时此刻，敌人可以利用它。

sentences.en: So given that fewer and fewer people want to fight, and war is obviously fundamentally about fighting, where is Ukrainian society's head right now on this war?
sentences.zh: 鉴于越来越少的人想要参战，而战争本质上显然是关于战斗的，乌克兰社会目前对这场战争的心态如何？

sentences.en: And what is their appetite to stop it?
sentences.zh: 他们结束战争的意愿有多强？

sentences.en: I mean, do people want to call it quits, agree to just, OK, lob off a third of their territory and give it to Russia and finally be done with this?
sentences.zh: 我是说，人们是想就此罢手，同意割让三分之一的领土给俄罗斯，然后彻底了结此事吗？

sentences.en: Or is a full draft kind of mass mobilization finally going to be on the table?
sentences.zh: 还是说全面的征兵和大规模动员终于要被提上日程了？

sentences.en: Well, this is what makes Zelensky's situation now so interesting, is he's in a bind.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是泽连斯基目前的处境如此有趣的原因，他陷入了进退维谷的境地。

sentences.en: He's ruling a country that, on the one hand, there's massive support for continuing the war.
sentences.zh: 他统治着这样一个国家，一方面，对于继续战争有着巨大的支持。

sentences.en: There's incredible anger at Russia, still seething anger at Russia over this war and no desire to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 对俄罗斯有着难以置信的愤怒，对这场战争依然充满怒火，毫无谈判的意愿。

sentences.en: On the other hand, you have fewer and fewer people actually willing to fight.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，实际愿意参战的人却越来越少。

sentences.en: So Zelensky is caught between these two positions and it's a difficult moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，泽连斯基夹在这两种立场之间，这是一个艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: OK, to summarize here,
sentences.zh: 好了，在此总结一下，

sentences.en: Zelensky's been pushing on these red lines abroad.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基一直在国外力推这些红线。

sentences.en: He's getting stuff.
sentences.zh: 他正在争取支持。

sentences.en: He made some progress last week, but it seems like it's not enough to dig himself out of the hole he's in.
sentences.zh: 他上周取得了一些进展，但这似乎还不足以让他摆脱目前的困境。

sentences.en: And at home, there's kind of a similar dynamic.
sentences.zh: 而在国内，情况也差不多。

sentences.en: He's done these small batch drafts of men, but that also seems like it's not enough to really win.
sentences.zh: 他分批进行过小规模征兵，但这似乎也远远不足以真正赢得胜利。

sentences.en: And now he's in this very hard place.
sentences.zh: 现在他陷入了极其艰难的境地。

sentences.en: And, you know, to put it very bluntly, it seems like a losing place.
sentences.zh: 而且，坦白来讲，这似乎是一个注定要输的局面。

sentences.en: Well, this is probably the moment of most uncertainty for Zelensky and for Ukraine since the beginning of the war.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对泽连斯基和乌克兰来说，这可能是自战争开始以来最充满不确定性的时刻。

sentences.en: There's no popular decision for Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 对泽连斯基来说，没有哪个决定是民心所向的。

sentences.en: Drafting more soldiers is unpopular.
sentences.zh: 征召更多士兵是不得人心的。

sentences.en: If he doesn't draft soldiers and settles in a ceasefire negotiation, that will also be unpopular.
sentences.zh: 如果他不征兵并通过停火谈判来解决问题，这也同样会不得人心。

sentences.en: Zelensky is really squeezed between two fires.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基真的被夹在两头受敌的绝境中。

sentences.en: And this is all against the backdrop of Russia escalating an offensive that's expected to continue through the summer.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切的背景是，俄罗斯正在升级攻势，预计这一攻势将持续到今年夏天。

sentences.en: How is he coping with this?
sentences.zh: 他是如何应对这一切的？

sentences.en: This is a lot on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 他肩上的担子实在太重了。

sentences.en: Well, this is something that we asked in the interview.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是我们在采访中向他提出的问题。

sentences.en: I just wanted to ask if you could say a few words about your own life as a wartime president.
sentences.zh: 我只是想请您谈谈您自己作为战时总统的生活。

sentences.en: And we talked to him on what was the 817th day of the war.
sentences.zh: 我们是在战争进入第817天时对他进行采访的。

sentences.en: I'm not afraid of working for many hours
sentences.zh: 我不怕长时间工作

sentences.en: and to do my work and many other works.
sentences.zh: 去做我的工作以及许多其他的工作。

sentences.en: But the hardest is the emotions.
sentences.zh: 但最难熬的是情绪。

sentences.en: You understand that?
sentences.zh: 你明白吗？

sentences.en: Emotions.
sentences.zh: 情绪。

sentences.en: He doesn't tell jokes like he used to.
sentences.zh: 他不像以前那样讲笑话了。

sentences.en: One aspect of the war is that his life as a comedian has really come to a close.
sentences.zh: 这场战争的一个方面是，他作为喜剧演员的生活真的结束了。

sentences.en: And he's become a much more serious public figure.
sentences.zh: 他变成了一个严肃得多的公众人物。

sentences.en: And I wake up very early.
sentences.zh: 我醒得很早。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: He said that he deals with some of the stresses of leadership by working out in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他说他通过在清晨健身来缓解一部分领导层的压力。

sentences.en: I can see my wife more often.
sentences.zh: 我能更常见到我妻子。

sentences.en: She's in the office.
sentences.zh: 她在办公室里。

sentences.en: But I see my children not that much.
sentences.zh: 但我见孩子的时间不多。

sentences.en: And he was most expressive and went on at some length about his family.
sentences.zh: 他谈起家人时感情最饱满，也说得比较详细。

sentences.en: It's the most happy moment.
sentences.zh: 这是最幸福的时刻。

sentences.en: And here I can relax.
sentences.zh: 在这里我可以放松。

sentences.en: Here's a relax.
sentences.zh: 在这里很轻松。

sentences.en: He said that through the course of the war his children have grown up.
sentences.zh: 他说，在战争期间，他的孩子们都长大了。

sentences.en: His daughter is now 19.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿现在19岁。

sentences.en: His son is 11.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子11岁。

sentences.en: And he said that he would spend time with his son working on Spanish homework.
sentences.zh: 他说他会陪儿子一起做西班牙语家庭作业。

sentences.en: I don't know Spanish in fact.
sentences.zh: 其实我并不懂西班牙语。

sentences.en: But I'm interested just in some time to spend with him whatever he does.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想找点时间陪他，不管他做什么。

sentences.en: And these are the happiest moments.
sentences.zh: 这些就是最幸福的时刻。

sentences.en: And here I can relax.
sentences.zh: 在这里我可以放松。

sentences.en: Andrew, how did you end the interview?
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，你是怎么结束这次采访的？

sentences.en: I asked him what he would do after the war.
sentences.zh: 我问他战后打算做什么。

sentences.en: And I thought his answer was telling.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他的回答意味深长。

sentences.en: So, what are your plans after the war?
sentences.zh: 那么，你战后有什么计划？

sentences.en: I would like after the war, after the victory, because those are different things.
sentences.zh: 我希望在战后，在胜利之后，因为那是两码事。

sentences.en: He said that there's a distinction between the end of the war and victory.
sentences.zh: 他说战争结束和取得胜利是有区别的。

sentences.en: I think that my plans depend on that.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的计划取决于这一点。

sentences.en: And then he described what would happen after victory.
sentences.zh: 接着他描述了胜利之后会发生什么。

sentences.en: He would spend time with his family and his dogs.
sentences.zh: 他会花时间和家人及狗狗在一起。

sentences.en: But what he left unsaid was what his life would look like if Ukraine lost the war.
sentences.zh: 但他没有说出口的是，如果乌克兰输掉这场战争，他的生活会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And what would it look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子呢？

sentences.en: Well, one scenario is that he could die at the end of this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一种可能是他可能会在最后丧命。

sentences.en: He's been the target of 10 assassination attempts, according to his government.
sentences.zh: 根据他政府的说法，他已经遭遇过10次暗杀。

sentences.en: Another possible outcome would be that Ukraine could lose a large chunk of its territory in a settlement agreement.
sentences.zh: 另一个可能的结果是，乌克兰可能会在停火协议中失去很大一部分领土。

sentences.en: So it's understandable why he didn't go into the details.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有细说也是可以理解的。

sentences.en: But it was still remarkable that he acknowledged just for a moment this vulnerability, this idea that there could be an outcome for Ukraine other than victory.
sentences.zh: 但难能可贵的是，他竟然片刻间承认了这种脆弱性，承认了乌克兰除了胜利之外还可能有别的结局。

sentences.en: Andrew, thank you.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Sunday,
sentences.zh: 周日，

sentences.en: Mexican voters elected the country's first woman and first Jewish president,
sentences.zh: 墨西哥选民选举出了该国第一位女总统兼第一位犹太裔总统，

sentences.en: Claudia Sheinbaum.
sentences.zh: 克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆。

sentences.en: Me convertiré en la primera mujer presidenta de Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我将成为墨西哥的第一位女总统。

sentences.en: It was a landslide victory for the 61-year-old climate scientist and former mayor of Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 这位61岁的气候科学家、墨西哥城前市长以压倒性优势获胜。

sentences.en: Sheinbaum, a leftist, had campaigned on a promise to continue the legacy of Mexico's current president,
sentences.zh: 作为一名左翼人士，谢因鲍姆在竞选时承诺延续墨西哥现任总统的政治遗产，

sentences.en: Andres Manuel López Obrador.
sentences.zh: 也就是安德雷斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔。
zh_words: 安德雷斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔

sentences.en: Gracias a la felicitación del presidente
sentences.zh: 感谢总统的祝贺

sentences.en: Andres Manuel López Obrador.
sentences.zh: 安德雷斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔。
zh_words: 安德雷斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔

sentences.en: Un hombre excepcional.
sentences.zh: 一个杰出的人。

sentences.en: Under Obrador, millions of Mexicans were lifted out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 在奥夫拉多尔的领导下，数百万墨西哥人摆脱了贫困。

sentences.en: But he was also criticized for failing to control rampant cartel violence.
sentences.zh: 但他也因未能控制猖獗的贩毒集团暴力活动而受到批评。

sentences.en: The election was the largest in Mexico's history, with the highest number of voters taking part.
sentences.zh: 这次选举是墨西哥历史上规模最大的一次，投票人数创下历史新高。

sentences.en: And it puts a Jewish leader at the helm of one of the world's largest, predominantly Catholic, countries.
sentences.zh: 这也将一位犹太裔领袖推上了这个全球最大的天主教人口为主的国家之一的最高权位。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 还有

sentences.en: President Biden is expected to sign an executive order on Tuesday, allowing him to temporarily seal the U.S.
sentences.zh: 预计拜登总统将于周二签署一项行政令，允许他在无证移民越境人数超过一定阈值时，

sentences.en: border with Mexico when the number of migrant crossings exceed a certain threshold.
sentences.zh: 临时关闭美国与墨西哥的边境。

sentences.en: The order would suspend protections for asylum seekers in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该行政令将暂停对美国境内寻求庇护者的保护，

sentences.en: and represents the most restrictive border policy instituted by Biden, who is under intense political pressure to address illegal migration.
sentences.zh: 这也是拜登为应对非法移民问题而承受巨大政治压力之下，所采取的最具限制性的边境政策。

sentences.en: Polls suggest that there is growing support, even inside the president's own party, for more aggressive border measures.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，采取更严厉边境措施的支持率正在不断上升，甚至在总统所在的党派内部也是如此。

sentences.en: The executive order is likely to be challenged in court.
sentences.zh: 这项行政令很可能会在法庭上遭到挑战。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由妮娜·费尔德曼制作，

sentences.zh: 克莱尔·特内斯凯特，

sentences.zh: 罗布·齐普科和黛安娜·阮制作，迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊提供协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Alicia Baitube, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由丽莎·乔伊编辑，包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和艾莉西亚·拜图贝创作的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行混音工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯维克创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨什科·丘布科。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.zh: 《威趣秀》节目中，我们将为您准备好迎接假期的待客之道。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家一样自在的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是对光线敏感的深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这非常讲究。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
